text:
kevin-partnerships: Heads up — vendor OrionCloud just told us part of PO #7891 (APAC pilot) is being rerouted due to port congestion. ETA bumped by ~+6 days. Need allocation plan, pinging @amy-ops and @sara-supply.

amy-ops: Copy. Do we have any split-shipment option? APAC pilot can't slip more than 48h.

sara-supply: Reached out to vendor. Manifest currently shows single container `CNTR-ORC-5532` with all 12 units. Vendor says port Y has a backlog, but may be able to do partial release for export hold.

orion-bot: Shipment update: `CNTR-ORC-5532` status changed to HELD_AT_PORT (Y). Estimated delay: 6 days. Tracking: https://tracker.vendor/orc/CNTR-ORC-5532

hiro: If pilot misses, can we pull from Dedicated buffer (reserved pool) in APAC or borrow from US/EU stock?

amy-ops: We have 12 reserved GPUs in the APAC buffer but 6 are promised to PartnerPilot B this week. So effectively 6 available.

matt-warehousing: We do have 8 units sitting in SIN staging (air-ready). Can reroute those to the pilot site in 48h, extra freight ~USD 3.2k per unit.

sara-supply: Vendor offered an air-split for 4 units (from the container) — transit 2 days but +USD 7k per unit. They can release paperwork today if we accept.

kevin-partnerships: Quick math: options are (A) 4 air from vendor + 4 reroute from SIN staging = 8 units in 48h, remaining 4 delayed; (B) 8 air = full on-time but high cost. What does finance say about threshold?

amy-ops: I can approve up to USD 20k extra without exec signoff. Above that needs VP Ops ok. 4 air @7k = 28k (too high). 4 air (+28k) + reroute 4*(3.2k)=12.8k => total ~40.8k.

kevin-partnerships: So option A still exceeds my approval. Alternative: do 4 air for the critical pilot nodes, reroute 4, and explain the delta to PartnerPilot B to see if they can accept a 48h shift.

sara-supply: I'll open a partial release request and a dispute for demurrage. Ticket: `SPLIT-REQ-1729`. Vendor asked for decision by EOD.

matt-warehousing: I'll prepare the SIN shipment hold and get freight quotes. If we go ahead, I can pick them up and have them on a plane within 24h.

hiro: I'll flag capacity in the marketplace and add a one-line note on the APAC capacity banner: "Limited availability — temporary routing delay." Will set TTL 72h.

amy-ops: I'll notify Sales/CS with the plan and draft the customer message. cc @kevin-partnerships for wording.

kevin-partnerships: Decision: proceed with 4 air (vendor) for the highest priority nodes + reroute 4 from SIN staging. Sara — proceed with `SPLIT-REQ-1729` and dispute. Matt — book reroute freight. Amy — cost approval up to 45k pending VP Ops if needed. Hiro — update marketplace banner.

sara-supply: On it. I'll also ask vendor for a signed SLA credit for the delay.

orion-bot: Task created: `logistics/1729` assigned to sara-supply, matt-warehousing. ETA updates will post here.

kevin-partnerships: Thanks team. Please post any vendor confirmations here. If vendor pushes for 8-air option, escalate to me immediately. :thumbsup:
